description:
A year ago, on the first snowy day, Hye-In sees her close older sister Jin-Young with a strange woman in her studio apartment, and since then, she has hated snowy days. She realizes her feelings for her older sister belatedly, but she realizes that she cannot be a 'girlfriend' rather than a 'close younger sister', and decides to take a leave of absence from school to avoid Jin-Young. After a party, she wakes up drunk and finds herself in her room. Jin-Young, who has been supporting her, is nagging her like an older sister again. Hye-In, who is annoyed by the atmosphere that always flows like this, tries to do what suits her best in this space late at night.

(Source: Ridibooks, translated)

*Note: Part of the 2024 Post Type GL Winter Anthology (\[GL\] 2024 포스타입 앤솔로지 | 겨울).*
